title: SpellUi::engine_task is an Option<Task> used as the 'engine build in flight' stage, cleared by hand in install_spell_engine
trigger: Pick a spelling language twice quickly in Appearance > Spelling: the second start_spell_engine drops the first task by overwrite; install clears the Option by hand
effect: None today (the task is dropped with the overwrite and install resets it); the stage is an Option kept in step with spell.info rather than one value
fix: enum EngineBuild { Idle, Building { chosen, _task } } owned by SpellUi, replaced whole on each start and on install

title: Media spoiler TileState::Building has no way out if the background build never answers
trigger: build_image_tile panics or the spawned task is cancelled with the app still alive: TILE stays Building
effect: Media spoiler specks never draw again for the session (cover still shows); text spoilers unaffected
fix: Building holds the task and a failure arm returns to Idle (or Failed) so the next frame can ask again
